name: Custom keyboards and input methods
meaning: A keyboard sees every keystroke. iOS sandboxes it and needs a separate Full Access toggle for network; Android IMEs have broader reach but show a risk warning.

android.prompt_ui: Settings > System > Languages & input > On screen keyboard; warning dialog
android.store_policy: Play: user data policy for IMEs
android.note: Password fields can use private IME options; keyboards can read clipboard when focused.

ios.prompt_ui: Settings > General > Keyboard > Keyboards; Full Access warning
ios.note: Secure fields force the system keyboard.

limits.headline: Can replace the on screen keyboard, but only after you add it and approve its warning
limits.user_action: You open Settings and switch on a new keyboard, then accept the warning
can: Type for you in any normal text field once you switch to it
Offer its own layouts, emoji and suggestions
See what you type, which is why both phones show a warning
cannot: Work in secure fields like passwords on iPhone; the system keyboard takes over
Turn itself on without you adding it in Settings
See what you type on iPhone without Full Access
limits.reach_label: Everything you type, if you allow
limits.differs: iPhone shows a Full Access warning and forces the system keyboard in secure fields. Android can use private options for password fields.

story.what_it_is: Replaces the phone's on screen keyboard with another one.
story.for_you: You pick a new keyboard for swipe typing, GIFs or AI help. You see a warning because a keyboard can see everything you type.
story.for_makers: Makers can offer better typing, languages and AI help. A keyboard sees every keystroke, so it is trusted and also a risk.

use_cases.example: A GIF keyboard lets you search and send a clip in a chat.
A keyboard built for people with limited movement.
An AI keyboard rewrites your message as you type.
A keyboard offers stickers and themes.
A parent controlled keyboard blocks unsafe words.
A malicious keyboard could log passwords, so secure fields use the system one.
A gaming keyboard adds quick chat phrases for team games.

risks: Full Access can send text out
story.android_note: A warning dialog appears. Keyboards can read the clipboard when in focus.
story.ios_note: Secure fields force the system keyboard. Full Access needs a separate switch.

technical_bounds: iOS bars them from secure text fields and phone pad

history.change: Full Access keystroke logging concerns documented
